description: Source-verified image acquisitions for the NZ GIS History timeline documentary wave 6. Each image is linked to a specific event with its date, creator, archive or publication, subject relationship and reuse terms. No event-specific reuse permission is inferred from a modern contextual export.

items.title: Calcomp 565 drum plotter, a computer mapping device
items.dateDisplay: Model introduced circa 1966; photograph date not established
items.credit: Ryan Somma; Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 2.0 Generic.
items.altText: A Calcomp 565 drum plotter used to produce computer-drawn maps, photographed at the Nemo Science Museum.
items.caption: Photograph of a Calcomp 565 drum plotter at the Nemo Science Museum, a model of computer-driven cartographic output.
items.context: The device is a period model associated with computer plotting; this is not the plotter used by a New Zealand surveying organisation in 1966.

items.title: DEC PDP-11/70 computer at a computer museum
items.commonsTitle: File:DEC PDP-11 at Computer Museum of America (23) (cropped).jpg
items.sourceName: Wikimedia Commons / Computer Museum of America
items.credit: Judson McCranie; Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported.
items.altText: A DEC PDP-11/70 computer displayed at the Computer Museum of America.
items.caption: Photograph of a DEC PDP-11/70 at the Computer Museum of America, taken in 2019.
items.context: MAPPAK is documented as running on a PDP-11. This later museum photograph shows a PDP-11/70 model, not the Lands and Survey machine or a MAPPAK workstation.

items.title: Intergraph CLIX workstation from the late 1980s
items.dateDisplay: Workstation circa late 1980s; photograph made in the late 1990s
items.credit: Gigs; photograph released into the public domain by the creator.
items.altText: An Intergraph CLIX computer workstation photographed after it had been decommissioned.
items.caption: Photograph of a decommissioned Intergraph CLIX workstation, a model from the late 1980s.
items.context: This late-1980s workstation provides computing context for early Intergraph use and teaching. It is a later photograph of a decommissioned unit, not equipment from DSIR, the University of Auckland or the University of Canterbury.

items.title: Modern redraw of the Arc/INFO coverage data model
items.dateDisplay: Diagram created 2021; based on an early-1980s Arc/INFO model
items.altText: A diagram of the Arc/INFO coverage data model showing spatial features and their related tables.
items.caption: A 2021 diagram explaining the Arc/INFO coverage data model.
items.context: This is a modern explanatory redraw of the early Arc/INFO coverage model, not an original 1982 interface screenshot or evidence of an installation at a New Zealand institution.

items.title: Department of Conservation wetland areas, 2026 service export
items.dateDisplay: Map export acquired 10 October 2026; underlying layer dates vary
items.sourceName: Environment Canterbury public ArcGIS service displaying Department of Conservation wetland data
items.credit: Crown Copyright: Department of Conservation Te Papa Atawhai 2026. Map rendering hosted by Environment Canterbury.
items.altText: Current map-service export showing a Department of Conservation wetland-area layer in Canterbury, without a basemap.
items.caption: A 2026 export of the Wetland Areas (DOC) layer from Environment Canterbury's public Land Resources and Conservation service. No basemap is included.
items.context: This current map export shows a DOC conservation-data layer and is a geographic example of the kind of information a conservation GIS can present. It is not a screenshot of the 2003 DOCgis Java client or Version 2. The layer data was licensed under CC BY 3.0 NZ and is credited to DOC.

items.title: Upper Hutt primary parcels, council map-service export
items.sourceName: Upper Hutt City Council Property Information feature service
items.credit: Land Information New Zealand; Upper Hutt City Council. Primary parcels sourced from LINZ Data Service. CC BY 4.0.
items.altText: Current parcel boundaries in an Upper Hutt council map-service export with no basemap.
items.caption: A current Upper Hutt primary-parcel layer export from the council's Property Information service. This is a generated map image, not a screenshot of the Xplorer interface.
items.context: This current service export shows land parcels maintained for Upper Hutt City Council, based on LINZ Data Service cadastral data. It illustrates the kind of council property mapping available online, but it is not the original 2003 Xplorer interface and does not establish the date when the council first adopted GIS.
